sections.content_text: Section 177 - Return of Withholding Tax (1) The following persons shall file a return of tax deducted or collected under the provisions of part 7 in such form as may be prescribed by the Board: (a) companies other than local authorities, autonomous bodies, any authority of the Government, primary or pre-primary schools teaching in Bengali, Govt. secondary or higher secondary schools, or any educational institution under Monthly Payment Order (MPO); (b) the firm; (c) association of individual; (d) private hospitals; (e) clinics; (f) diagnostic Centre. (2) Return under sub-section (1)- (a) the taxpayer shall file with the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes under whose jurisdiction; (b) the relevant particulars and information in the prescribed form and accompanying schedules, statements, accounts, appendices or documents shall be submitted; (c) shall be signed and executed in the manner described in subsection (5) of section 169; (3) The return under sub-section (1) shall be filed at the following times, namely:- (a) the applicable return for the preceding month shall be filed by the 15″ (fifteenth) day of every month; and (b) the next office opening day where the 15″ (fifteenth) day of any month is a weekly or public holiday; (4) The Deputy Commissioner of Taxes may extend the time for filing the return under this section by not more than 15 (fifteen) days from the due date or up to the last day of the said month. (5) The Board may, by notification in the Official Gazette, prescribe the scope, form and manner of filing returns in electronic, machine-readable or computer-readable medium. Moreover, as per
